summary: Weather, corruption and the dual clocks: cthulhu_heat as its own dimension with its own inputs, a deterministic per-region daily weather step, accumulation-only cell corruption, the three confrontation triggers, and the state gate on Cthulhu assistance.

coordination.notes: expedition.rs: three serde(default) fields appended at the END of ExpeditionState's field list with their initialisers at the end of new()'s literal, plus one weather step inside resolve_midnight_in after S4's 24 strategic hours and before the character-scale Midnight Return. Other lanes appending fields to the same struct tail merge with this. save_migration.rs: EXPECTED_CURRENT_KEYS gains cthulhu_heat, weather and corruption in struct order. blocked: needs decision -- corruption reversibility/decay, Cthulhu early-elimination rules and summoning-interruption rules are Open (brief section 20); accumulation only is implemented and no decay path exists. needs authored id -- CONFRONTATION_DISCOVERY_ID is a placeholder constant, not an authored observation, until a C card authors the deliberate-discovery record. needs decision -- every heat amount and MAX_HEAT are provisional tuning (GAME_BUILD_PLAN.md forbids implementation inventing clock tuning); the shape is the deliverable, the numbers are not approved. The assistance event itself is S7/S10 territory; S8 ships only the gate.
